newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: SWIMMING-SMITH UNCOMMITTED ON SEVILLE AND PERTH.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-SMITH UNCOMMITTED ON SEVILLE AND PERTH.

text.p: Ireland's triple Olympic champion Michelle Smith has not committed herself to either the European swimming championships in August or the world championships in Perth next January, the Irish Times reported on Wednesday.
The newspaper said Smith would compete in five events at an international long-course meeting in Charleroi, Belgium, this weekend.
"I will be staying on for a week's long-course training and will round this off by competing in a similar international meet in Bruges (Belgium) on May 25 and 26," Smith said.
